behaviour: Export DEFAULT_PAGE_ID and DEFAULT_PAGE_NAME shared constants for default page initialization and fallback resolution.
rules: 1. Export DEFAULT_PAGE_ID = "page-default" and DEFAULT_PAGE_NAME = "Page 1" as string constants at the end of packages/common/src/constants.ts.
2. Do not invoke any random or dynamic function when defining these constants.

behaviour: Add optional pageId?: string property to _ExcalidrawElementBase so every ExcalidrawElement can carry page membership.
rules: 1. Add optional pageId?: string; to _ExcalidrawElementBase right after customData?: Record<string, any>;.

behaviour: Allow optional pageId in ElementConstructorOpts and attach pageId to newly created elements only when explicitly provided and non-default.
rules: 2. Add "pageId" to the MarkOptional union of ElementConstructorOpts.

3. In _newElementBase, spread ...(rest.pageId && rest.pageId !== DEFAULT_PAGE_ID ? { pageId: rest.pageId } : {}) onto the returned element object so default-page elements do not gain an own pageId property and existing snapshots do not change.

sites.rule: Add DEFAULT_PAGE_ID to the import from @excalidraw/common.
Conditionally spread pageId onto element only when rest.pageId is truthy and not DEFAULT_PAGE_ID.

behaviour: Filter Scene active-page element getters and maps by activePageId while maintaining all-pages element collections and casting Mutable<ExcalidrawElement> when stamping pageId in replaceAllElements.
rules: 1. In Scene.replaceAllElements, cast (element as Mutable<ExcalidrawElement>).pageId = existingPageId and (element as Mutable<ExcalidrawElement>).pageId = this.activePageId instead of assigning directly to read-only element.pageId so TypeScript compilation succeeds.

sites.rule: Cast element to Mutable<ExcalidrawElement> when assigning element.pageId in replaceAllElements.

behaviour: Use all-pages element maps and merged elements in Store.scheduleMicroAction so active-page updates never mark inactive-page elements as deleted.
rules: 2. Pass this.app.scene.getMergedElements(params.elements) into syncInvalidIndicesImmutable when params.elements is defined.

sites.rule: Use getAllElementsMapIncludingDeleted() and getMergedElements(params.elements) in scheduleMicroAction.
